trello.name: Implement queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Configure alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet, not just payment workers. Set warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and page threshold at 5,000 jobs. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Refactor the `_process_with_retry` function in `payment_worker.py` to implement exponential backoff with jitter and cap retries. Ensure failed jobs are re-enqueued to a dead-letter queue at the back, not the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503s to verify the fix. Owner: Marta.

trello.name: Split and increase database connection pool
trello.desc: Update the configuration to separate the database connection pools for workers and the API to prevent coupling. Increase the worker pool size from the default of 20 to 100. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Update the payment incident runbook to replace old Kibana links with new logging links. Document the queue drain procedure improvised during the outage. Verify and update escalation phone numbers, removing any contacts for employees who have left the company. Owner: Priya.

trello.name: Automate status page updates for checkout errors
trello.desc: Wire the status page API to the checkout error rate alert so that the status page automatically flips to 'Investigating' with a template message when the alert fires. Owner: Marta.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Draft a plan for a controlled chaos test of the payment processor failover. The plan must include a staging test, a production low-traffic window test, and a rollback plan. Note: Do not execute the test until the plan is reviewed in two weeks. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Schedule Redis upgrade to 7.2
trello.desc: Schedule a proper change window to upgrade Redis from EOL version 6.0 to 7.2. Account for config renames and changed persistence defaults during the migration. Owner: Kofi.
